response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats as batting_hand, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count, AVG(cnt) as avg_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / total_count as share, cnt * 1.0 / avg_count as count_divided_by_avg FROM hand_counts CROSS JOIN totals
